mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring any specific trigger condition.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative equity returns over the subsequent 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which drives positive equity returns as corporate earnings prospects improve over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS growth fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's tightening response (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) leads to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days as real rates rise and growth concerns mount.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 6.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific trigger.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units within a 2-month window signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1200.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness typically leads to negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate hiring freezes and reduced consumer spending weigh on economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM) and a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS growth fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
